purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for schema versions, compatibility findings, migration/backfill progress, dual-version state, cutover criteria and rollback readiness.

topics.name: DWH Schema Migration Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for schema versions, compatibility findings, migration/backfill progress, dual-version state, cutover criteria and rollback readiness.

semantics.identity_rule: Schema version, migration definition, execution/batch, record revision and snapshot identities remain distinct.
semantics.derived_rule: Compatibility/cutover readiness is displayed as derived evidence, not active state by itself.
semantics.action_rule: validate/start/pause/resume/cutover/rollback operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing migration state grants no migration/cutover authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Version/migration/transformation edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Irreversible changes, incompatible consumers, failed backfills and rollback data-loss risks are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: Schema evolution is an explicit versioned migration between exact schema identities/versions with validated compatibility and data transformation provenance; runtime/file order never silently changes active data meaning.

hard_gates.condition: monitor treats compatibility as completed migration

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for schema versions, compatibility findings, migration/backfill progress, dual-version state, cutover criteria and rollback readiness.
